text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Gone in a flash. I can hardly believe<n>summer camp
is over already.
The Mainichi Okan is just a month<n>away.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Which means! We can finally SETTLE<n>THE
SCOOORE!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Oh, El. I see you're as energetic as<n>ever today.
And you're as tranquila as ever!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
But... Heh heh! I know ya reached a<n>new level this
summer!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
That's what I love to see! That's<n>why we've gotta
do this!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
You got that? I'll be waitin' for ya at<n>the Mainichi
Okan!

Um, I hate to put a damper on your<n>dramatic exit,
but...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I see you every day. We're going<n>back home to the
same exact dorm<n>room, and we'll be sitting next to
each other for the whole bus ride<n>there.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: C'mon! Por favor! You're supposed<n>to play along!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
And so, my summer camp with Grass<n>Wonder
comes to a close!
